scope: Requirements sections 12.6-12.8 only; sentence-level clauses retain every conjunct; not whole-document coverage

clauses.source_clause: For an individual camera/segment, display relevant measured-weather plots aligned to the video's source interval.
clauses.acceptance_case: Load each camera/segment and prove plot query bounds equal its owned source interval; do not substitute the calendar day.

clauses.source_clause: Playback moves a UTC cursor; selecting a chart instant, keogram bin or event interval seeks the corresponding video position.
clauses.acceptance_case: Play, click chart, click keogram and select event; assert the UTC cursor and player position agree in each direction.

clauses.source_clause: Use the authoritative source-time map and rational frame boundaries, not percentage of retained frames or nearest telemetry array index.
clauses.acceptance_case: Use nonuniform missing captures and rational frame centers; assert mapping follows the authoritative time map, not array percentage or nearest weather sample.

clauses.source_clause: Clamp/select only within the owned interval and represent uncertainty/precision honestly.
clauses.acceptance_case: Test before start, exact start, last frame and exact exclusive end; retain window-level uncertainty and reject adjacent-segment seeks.

clauses.source_clause: Plots show units, metric-specific coverage, explicit gaps and the chosen aggregate resolution.
clauses.acceptance_case: Inspect visible units, coverage, gaps and aggregate resolution for every plotted metric, including partial coverage.

clauses.source_clause: A shared station value is not a separate camera measurement.
clauses.acceptance_case: Compare the same UTC interval across cameras; station evidence identity/value remains shared and is labeled as measured station data.

clauses.source_clause: The time cursor may move through a weather gap without inventing a value; missing video shows its partial/unavailable state instead of jumping over elapsed time.
clauses.acceptance_case: Play across a telemetry gap and a partial/unavailable video; no interpolated measurement or hidden source-time jump is introduced.

clauses.source_clause: Source-time zoom and UTC/offset-bearing labels must behave correctly overnight and across DST.
clauses.acceptance_case: Zoom across midnight and both DST transitions; repeated local times display distinct offsets and stable UTC selection.

clauses.source_clause: Shareable links preserve camera, segment and source-time selection.
clauses.acceptance_case: Open copied links in a fresh browser; camera, segment and source selection round-trip including offset-bearing dates.

clauses.source_clause: Keyboard controls and text summaries offer equivalent navigation; on mobile use one active player and bounded chart points.
clauses.acceptance_case: Complete equivalent seeks using keyboard/text controls; mobile keeps one active player and enforces the admitted point bound.

clauses.source_clause: Multi-camera simultaneous playback is not an initial requirement.
clauses.acceptance_case: Confirm release acceptance never requires synchronized simultaneous multi-camera playback.

clauses.source_clause: Publish valid AI descriptions automatically with clear AI/analysis-mode labels; do not make operator review a media/AI publication gate.
clauses.acceptance_case: Publish a valid analysis with no operator session; retain explicit AI and native-video/sampled-frame labels without holding media publication.

clauses.source_clause: Provide an authenticated private interface for description/event corrections, tags, favorites and poster selection.
clauses.acceptance_case: Exercise authorized description/event changes, tags, favorites and poster selection; verify the private interface exposes all five functions.

clauses.source_clause: D13 must use the qualified fleet identity/access pattern with explicit operator authorization, server-side checks on every write and read of private data, CSRF/session protections as applicable, and a separate least-privilege database role.
clauses.acceptance_case: Deny unauthorized private reads and writes, invalid CSRF/session requests and spoofed actors; verify the editor DB role cannot perform unrelated administration.

clauses.source_clause: No public account/subscription system is required.
clauses.acceptance_case: Browse and play anonymously without account registration or subscription infrastructure.

clauses.source_clause: Neither a hidden path nor LAN origin is sufficient authorization.
clauses.acceptance_case: Repeat private read/write attempts from LAN and a discovered hidden URL without operator authority; both are denied.

clauses.source_clause: Preserve the immutable validated automated revision and human editorial revisions separately.
clauses.acceptance_case: Rerun AI and edit as a human; immutable automated and human histories remain separately retrievable to authorized operators.

clauses.source_clause: Private raw model responses/validation diagnostics keep the short bounded lifecycle in §13.7 rather than an indefinite editorial-retention requirement.
clauses.acceptance_case: Expire private raw diagnostics at the qualified short lifecycle while preserving required validated editorial/audit revisions.

clauses.source_clause: Record actor, timestamp, reason, old/new revision and input/media/evidence identities.
clauses.acceptance_case: Read audit after each edit; actor, time, reason, old/new revision and input/media/evidence IDs are complete and server-controlled.

clauses.source_clause: Writes use compare-and-set and reject stale edits.
clauses.acceptance_case: Race two edits on one expected revision; exactly one commits and the other reports conflict without side effects.

clauses.source_clause: An active human override remains active across routine analysis reruns against unchanged evidence.
clauses.acceptance_case: Rerun analysis against unchanged evidence; an active human override and its attribution remain effective.

clauses.source_clause: If bound media or measured evidence changes, retain the revision for review but invalidate dependent public/search claims until they are reconciled; unaffected text can remain current when its evidence binding still holds.
clauses.acceptance_case: Change bound media and measured evidence separately; dependent public/search claims withdraw, old edits stay reviewable and unaffected evidence-bound text remains current.

clauses.source_clause: Show new evidence for deliberate replace/rebase rather than silently treating an old correction as newly reviewed.
clauses.acceptance_case: Rebase onto changed evidence explicitly; show old/new bindings and require a new audited decision rather than silent approval.

clauses.source_clause: Do not present a human correction as an untouched AI output, or let free-form text overwrite measured station values.
clauses.acceptance_case: Reject measured-value mutation through editor fields and event text; public human corrections retain human attribution distinct from validated AI history.

clauses.source_clause: Corrections, explicitly published tags and poster choices atomically update active metadata via the outbox, generate a new sidecar/public revision, invalidate relevant caches and enqueue text reindexing.
clauses.acceptance_case: Inject failure around the transaction and outbox dispatch; active metadata/audit/outbox commit atomically, and replay converges sidecar, cache and index to one revision.

clauses.source_clause: Withdraw the outdated searchable text immediately; while reindexing, typed/lexical browsing follows the current public revision.
clauses.acceptance_case: Hold reindexing and query lexical/vector/typed paths; no old text leaks and current typed/lexical results remain available under the current public revision.

clauses.source_clause: Favorites and operator-only notes remain private by default and must not enter public search/sidecars.
clauses.acceptance_case: Set private favorite/note then inspect public API, sidecar, cache, export and search; neither value nor private field appears.

clauses.source_clause: Poster choices use §11.4's genuine retained/decoded-source rules.
clauses.acceptance_case: Select a genuine retained still or qualified decoded published-video frame; reject expired source, invented URL, adjacent-camera identity and unripe preview bypass.

clauses.source_clause: Cover concurrent automated/human edits, revocation, rollback, audit visibility, model outage and restored revision state in acceptance tests.
clauses.acceptance_case: Exercise automated/human races, revoked identity, rollback, authorized audit viewing, inference outage and isolated restore; preserve revision precedence and privacy.

clauses.source_clause: Provide a small responsive card served by Weather and embedded on the existing `vallery.net` site.
clauses.acceptance_case: WX-44 qualifies the Weather card with a controlled parent fixture; OWN-EMBED then delivers the actual main-site embed, and WX-33 verifies that live integration. An isolated demo cannot close integrated acceptance.

clauses.source_clause: Use a self-hosted iframe route as the starting design, with a narrow `frame-ancestors` allowlist for the actual approved main-site origins.
clauses.acceptance_case: Test every approved parent origin and an unapproved origin against response CSP; only the card route permits the precise owner-approved ancestors.

clauses.source_clause: Keep normal/private application routes protected against unwanted framing.
clauses.acceptance_case: Attempt framing normal pages and private editor routes; neither inherits the card framing exception.

clauses.source_clause: The parent site embedding change belongs to its existing owner/repository workflow and must be linked as an implementation prerequisite; Weather's public repository does not own unrelated main-site code.
clauses.acceptance_case: Verify native order WX-44 → OWN-EMBED → WX-33; the WordPress owner supplies parent source/live evidence before integrated acceptance. Parent delivery is not a prerequisite for constructing its card.

clauses.source_clause: The card reads the same sanitized current-weather contract, refreshes about every 15 seconds while visible, shows measured timestamps/staleness and links to the full site.
clauses.acceptance_case: Compare card and main current-weather responses; visible polling is approximately 15 seconds and measured timestamps/staleness/link remain truthful.

clauses.source_clause: Use bounded requests and pause unnecessary polling in hidden views.
clauses.acceptance_case: Hide and restore the view; no overlapping poll accumulation, hidden polling stops where unnecessary and resumption refreshes without a retry burst.

clauses.source_clause: It must work without third-party scripts/fonts/widgets, camera credentials, parent-page access, public visitor accounts or privileged cookies.
clauses.acceptance_case: Load in a fresh cookie-free browser with third-party requests blocked; card works without parent DOM access, privileged cookies, accounts or camera credentials.

clauses.source_clause: Its framing policy does not authorize arbitrary API CORS or admin embedding.
clauses.acceptance_case: Attempt cross-origin API access and private-route framing from the allowed parent; card framing does not grant broader CORS or admin access.

clauses.source_clause: Test narrow mobile containers, unavailable data, reduced-motion/keyboard access and allowed/denied framing origins.
clauses.acceptance_case: Test narrow containers, unavailable/stale data, keyboard and reduced motion, plus allowed and denied parent origins in real browsers.

12.7: D13 live identity/operator role and session policy
D16 diagnostic lifecycle and cache withdrawal bounds
12.8: OWN-EMBED actual origin allowlist and parent deployment
